newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil IBGE sees 76.41 mln tonnes grains/oilseeds.
newsitem.headline: Brazil IBGE sees 76.41 mln tonnes grains/oilseeds.

text.p: Brazilian production of grains and oilseeds could reach 76.41 million tonnes, up almost five percent up from the 73.02 million tonnes production in 1996, said the National Statistics Institute (IBGE) in a statement.
This estimate however is based on some simulations, principally for winter crops such as wheat while some forecasts for the northeast of the country are using planting intentions only, it added.
Soybean production is seen at 24.24 million tonnes, up 8.67 percent from 1996 due to beneficial prices and expectations of improved productivity, the IBGE said.
The first corn harvest is seen reaching 28.12 million tonnes, a rise of 6.88 percent on the previous crop.
((-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
